subject: ❌ Office Hours Cancelled — $instructor_name on $booking_date
body:
Dear $student_name,

This confirms that your office hours booking has been cancelled. The slot is now released and available for another student.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CANCELLED BOOKING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Booking ID:    $booking_id
Instructor:    $instructor_name ($instructor_id)
Original Date: $booking_date  ($day_of_week)
Original Time: $start_time – $end_time
Location:      $location
Cancelled By:  $cancelled_by
Cancelled On:  $cancelled_on
Reason:        $cancellation_reason

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If this cancellation was a mistake, you can rebook via the Student Portal — but please note that the slot is no longer reserved for you. Frequent late cancellations are visible to your instructor.

If you still need help on the topic you booked for, alternative options include:

  • Booking a different office-hours slot with the same instructor.
  • Reaching out via the module discussion board.
  • Contacting your academic advisor for ongoing support.

Kind regards,
Academics Office
